newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-FORTUNA SITTARD SIGN INTERNATIONAL GRAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FORTUNA SITTARD SIGN INTERNATIONAL GRAY.

text.p: Dutch first division side Fortuna Sittard have signed Northern Ireland striker Philip Gray from French side Nancy, the Dutch news agency ANP said on Friday.
The 28-year-old Gray, who has won 25 caps, signed a 2-1/2-year contract for an undisclosed transfer fee.

Gray, who is in the Northern Ireland squad for Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Albania, started his career at Tottenham Hotspur and had spells with Luton Town and Sunderland before joining Nancy this summer.
He is expected to make his debut on Wednesday in Fortuna's league match against NAC Breda.
